messages.subject: version 3.1-0 released
messages.body_plain:
Hi,
   We just released version 3.1-0 of Zelig. You can install it via

install.packages("Zelig", repos = "http://gking.harvard.edu")

   The version will also appear on CRAN soon. This version has major 
improvements over the previous one. It inclues many new models such as 
ANOVA, generalized estimating equations models, mixed effects models, Cox 
proportional hazard model, and compound hierarchical ordinal probit 
regression for survey vignettes. It also contains many bug fixes. Please 
try it out and send us feedback!

   We have also updated our paper which outlines the ideas behind Zelig. 
The paper is available at:
http://gking.harvard.edu/files/abs/z-abs.shtml

Cheers,
Kosuke
